newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen higher at start.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen higher at start.

text.p: Wall Street stocks, underpinned by a steady bond market, are expected to move higher at the start of trading on Wednesday, following through on the second largest advance in Dow history.
The Dow industrials rallied 173 points on Tuesday to close at 6,834, driven by short covering and programme trading which made for a mixed performance in the broad market.
Trading will unfold in anticipation of the first quarter earnings report due from International Business Machines Corp after the market closes on Wednesday.
